title: Wrecker
description: The massive muscle of the Bad Batch, the boisterous Wrecker also acted as their demolitions specialist. While he looked intimidating from the outside, he had a kindness that allowed him to bond with Omega. He even gave Omega his tooka doll, Lula. Though Wrecker and most of his team resisted Order 66, he had to finally have his inhibitor chip removed to prevent him from being a danger to the team.
